observations: Photo 0 shows the front of a black Xbox console with a power/vent area and a warning label; no ports/cables/adaptor shown.
Photo 1 shows the top/front of the console with a black game controller placed on it; controller buttons and sticks are visible.
No photo shows the console model number (e.g., One/S/X), serial label, or the adaptor/charging brick.
No photo shows the included games, packaging, or receipt.

claims.claim: Xbox one with one pad for sell
claims.evidence: Photos show an Xbox console and one controller, but the exact Xbox model (One/One S/One X) and that it is the only pad are not confirmed by photo.
No games are shown in the photos.
No adaptor/brick or power connection is shown; only the console front/top is visible.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired
claims.evidence: No seals/inside photos or warranty/repair indicators are shown.
No ports are shown and no test/benchmark or gameplay video is provided.

claims.claim: Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt
claims.evidence: No receipt or packaging is shown; controller authenticity/originality is not verifiable from photos.

risks.risk: Console power/adaptor fault may prevent booting or cause intermittent shutdown (seller says adaptor issue, but the exact fault is unknown).
risks.proof: Seller video: connect adaptor, power on from cold, show dashboard loading and controller pairing; include a close-up of the adaptor/brick label and the power port connection.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully working / needs adaptor replacement or repair until proven otherwise.

risks.risk: Exact Xbox model (One vs One S vs One X) affects value and compatibility.
risks.proof: Photo of the console rear/underside label showing model and serial (or a clear shot of the model text).
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest-value Xbox One variant until the model is confirmed.

risks.risk: Ports may be faulty (HDMI/USB/Ethernet) even if the console powers on.
risks.proof: Video showing HDMI output to TV and at least one USB device (or controller charging) working; show Ethernet port if available.
risks.if_unproven: Price as ports not guaranteed working.

risks.risk: Games may be missing, wrong titles, or discs/cases may be damaged.
risks.proof: Clear photos of all 6 game cases/discs (front/back) and a quick show of one disc being read in the console.
risks.if_unproven: Price as no games included until the 6 titles are verified.

risks.risk: Controller may be non-original or may have drift/button faults.
risks.proof: Video of controller connected and a quick test showing all buttons and sticks responding (including stick drift check).

proof_requests: Photo of the console rear/underside label (model + serial).
Photo/close-up of the adaptor/brick and the power port connection.
Video: cold boot to dashboard + controller pairing + quick gameplay or menu navigation.
Photos of all 6 games (cases/discs) and a short clip showing one game launching/reading.
Video test of controller buttons and both analog sticks (no drift).
response.reason: The photos confirm an Xbox console and one controller, but the key pricing drivers (exact model, adaptor/power fault, and included games/receipt) are not verifiable from the images. With an adaptor issue claimed, we need proof of boot and model identity before pricing.
